title: Check if all list items are unique
description: Write a function `all_unique(items)` that returns whether every item in `items` appears exactly once.
hints: Idea to consider: a set automatically drops duplicates
set(items) keeps only one copy of each distinct value - if that set ends up smaller than the original list, at least one value was repeated.
expected_behavior: Returns True if no item repeats, False otherwise.
explanation: Comparing the length before and after removing duplicates (via a set) is a common idiom for 'were there any duplicates at all' without needing to identify which value repeated.
